ult_shapes.timed: a field around the hero for `duration` s; every `tick` s it hits everything with d in [hero - 0.5, hero + `range`] (the Meta-1 storm / rift; `ahead` places the rift's visual)
ult_shapes.waves: `waves` bands `spacing` u deep, `gap` s apart, from `from` to `to` u ahead of the cast point; each band hits once
ult_shapes.drop: an impact `ahead` u in front (at the hero's x with `at_x`), `radius` u: `pulses` hits `gap` s apart (one when absent)
ult_shapes.area: a band from `from` to `to` u ahead, `width` u wide at the hero's x (null = the full bridge): hits once; its front runs from `from` to `to` in `sweep` s (at once when absent) and it stays `duration` s
ult_shapes.beam: a corridor `width` u wide down the hero's x from `from` to `to` u ahead for `duration` s, hitting every `tick` s
ult_shapes.fan: `rays` rays over `angle` degrees from the hero's x, `length` u long, for `duration` s; each ray hits every `tick` s (a squad takes at most `per_squad_max` rays per tick)
ult_shapes.wall: a barrier `width` u wide, `ahead` u in front, that travels with the army for `duration` s: it absorbs (`absorb`), squads reaching it fight it first (`wall_hp`)
ult_shapes.ward: a window of `duration` s on the army: soldiers lost meanwhile are recorded (x `record`) and at the close min(recorded, `return` + `return_pool` x revive pool) come back
ult_shapes.flock: birds fly over the squads in `waves` waves `gap` s apart to every structure of `targets` within `reach` u ahead: each structure takes `breaks` (an equal share per wave), squads under the flight path `kills`

ult_fields.duration: s the ult or the part lasts
ult_fields.tick: s between the hits of a lasting shape
ult_fields.range: u ahead a timed ult hits
ult_fields.ahead: u in front of the hero where the shape is placed
ult_fields.from: u ahead where the shape starts
ult_fields.to: u ahead where the shape ends
ult_fields.width: u across the bridge (null = the full bridge)
ult_fields.sweep: s for an area's front to run from `from` to `to`
ult_fields.per_squad_max: rays one squad takes per tick at most
ult_fields.leap_s: s the visual leap out and back takes at most (logic x stays under the thumb)
ult_fields.kills: soldiers removed per squad per hit
ult_fields.breaks: hp removed per structure per hit
ult_fields.gate_hits: hero hits on every gate in the shape per hit
ult_fields.neg_gate_hits: hero hits on every negative gate of the next gate row
ult_fields.fortress: at the siege the hit lands on the fortress (it takes `breaks`)
ult_fields.ground: s a Flying squad hit stays grounded
ult_fields.ground_after: a Flying squad hit stays grounded until the ult ends + this many s
ult_fields.statuses: status id (ArsenalData.STATUSES; seal = BRAND) -> stacks per hit (lengths: the status rule's)
ult_fields.stagger_s: s of STAGGER when the sheet gives it
ult_fields.burn_s: s of BURN when the sheet gives it
ult_fields.freeze_s: s of the FREEZE the CHILL stacks end in
ult_fields.paint_s: s the biggest squad hit stays PAINTED
ult_fields.reveal: u ahead hidden gates and Phantom squads are revealed (-1 = the whole screen)
ult_fields.mark_phantoms: the revealed Phantom squads are MARKed
ult_fields.slow: hazards, turrets, squads and clash losses run at 1 - slow while it lasts
ult_fields.armor_time: s the army ignores hazards and turrets
ult_fields.hold: s squads touching the hold area are held (no advance, no clash damage, STAGGERed)
ult_fields.hold_width: u, width of the hold area
ult_fields.clash_loss: squads hit lose this much more in clashes
ult_fields.clash_loss_s: s it lasts (null = their next clash)
ult_fields.strip_s: s squads caught fight as plain squads (Armored / Shielded off)
ult_fields.silence_s: s turrets on the path miss every shot
ult_fields.heal_pool: share of the revive pool the army regains on top
ult_fields.record: x on the soldiers a ward records
ult_fields.return: base of a ward's return at the close
ult_fields.return_pool: share of the revive pool added to a ward's return cap
ult_fields.revive: fallen champions revived (1 = the first, -1 = all)
ult_fields.revive_hp: HP share they stand up with
ult_fields.wall_hp: HP of a wall (x ult power)
ult_fields.contact_breaks: breaks on the barricade a wall absorbs
ult_fields.volleys: army volley damage + (bucket 2) while the blob centre is inside the field
ult_fields.breaks_per_s: breaks per second while it burns

ult_parts.extra: the follow-up hit that carries the hero's second ult number (HeroData.HEROES.ult2)
ult_parts.status_at: ULT_TIMING -> statuses put on squads at that moment ({target, reach | radius, statuses, ..._s})

ult_timing.end: when the ult ends / the ward closes
ult_timing.wave: as one more wave after the last
ult_timing.land: where the flock lands (every struck structure)

ult_targets.strip: a strip `width` u wide from the ult's place to `to` u ahead
ult_targets.struck: every squad within `radius` u of a struck structure
ult_targets.farthest: the fortress gate at the siege, else the farthest structure struck
ult_targets.volleys: the army's volleys (statuses on their targets)

squads.doc: >= count living squads with d in [hero + from, hero + reach] (from 0)

lane.doc: >= count hostiles (squads and structures) in the hero's lane within reach

fan.doc: >= count squads inside the ult's fan (its angle and length)

structures.doc: >= count structures of kinds within reach

hazards.doc: a hazard row of kinds ([] = any) within reach

gate_row.doc: the next gate row within reach (hidden: only while it has unrevealed values)

clash.doc: a clash is on or starts within `within` s

army_loss.doc: >= share of the army lost in the last window s

absorb_kinds.turret: a turret shot at the army

attack_patterns.boulder: a heavy shot with splash (Горан's rock, Вартан's rivet; HeroKinds.ATTACK_BOULDER)
attack_patterns.swing: melee swings in an arc (`arc` u or `arc_deg` degrees)
attack_patterns.beam: rays that ignore the Shielded pool

attack_fields.splash: extra kills around a squad target (kit)
attack_fields.pierce: squads a shot passes through (-1 = the whole corridor)
attack_fields.statuses: status id (ArsenalData.STATUSES; seal = BRAND) -> proc per hit
attack_fields.ground: s a Flying squad hit stays grounded
attack_fields.reground: s before the same squad can be grounded again
attack_fields.reveal_rows: hidden gate rows a gate hit reveals
attack_fields.focus_mult: x when spare rays converge on fewer targets
attack_fields.drones: ward-drones, each absorbs one turret shot at the army
attack_fields.drone_contact_cd: s, shared cooldown of a drone absorbing a blade / barricade contact
attack_fields.mend_share: share of soldiers lost that feed the revive pool (Healer Mend)
attack_fields.frozen_clash_loss: the army's clash losses vs a squad she froze x (1 + this)
attack_fields.burn_jumps: squads her BURN jumps to on a wipe
attack_fields.burning_machines: machine damage + on burning squads (bucket 2, inside TEAM_B2_CAP)
attack_fields.burning_volleys: army volley damage + on burning structures
attack_fields.soldiers: soldiers back from the revive pool
attack_fields.reveals: reveals the Phantom it lands on
attack_fields.rail_dx: u between a rail and x
attack_fields.shield_cd: s cooldown of the front-champion shield
attack_fields.weaken: the squad deals this much less clash damage
attack_fields.fallback: biggest_squad when no structure is in reach

attack_procs.throw: a throw to the `target` hostile within `reach` for x `mult`
attack_procs.mend: `soldiers` come back from the revive pool
attack_procs.eye: plants an Eye: `soldiers` come back when that squad is wiped
attack_procs.echo: repeats `share` of the hit on the next structure within `reach` behind
attack_procs.burst: an explosion `r` u at the target
attack_procs.lance: pierces the whole corridor for x `mult`
attack_procs.strip: a burning strip across the bridge
attack_procs.flinch: the next squad in the lane is STAGGERed
attack_procs.guard: intercepts one hit of `kinds` per `cd` s
